findings.why: I paused at “the first” to supply “orgasm” before the end of the sentence made sense.
I stopped to work out what “the game” referred to, since I hadn't yet encountered a game, then had to reconnect “that wanting” with her response to the question.
After following the wind across the quad, I had to shift back to her hair to attach “black and fine” to the right thing.
I paused over “the ones,” unsure whether it meant their outings, his ideas, or something from the afternoon in bed.
At “better than it had any right to,” I briefly lost track of whether I was picturing the curls or the blowout and backed up.
“The closed camel-coat project” made me stop and search my memory for a woman described that way. That interrupted the long sentence, and I had to pick up the laughing woman again.
I reread “Randi giving half a head and enough weight” to work out their relative sizes and how the collision looked. At first I read “giving” as something she physically did during the bump.
